tasks.final_text: The men's singles was a tennis event held as part of the tennis program at the 1904 Summer Olympics  It was the third time the event was held at the Olympics. There were 27 competitors from 2 nations.  The event was won Beals Wright, with the Americans sweeping the medals.

I have a winter home in the Yucatan in a town called Progreso, which is a small beach town. It is on a barrier island, so no part of the town is very far from the beach. In the case of my condo, the nearest beach, which I call the "baby beach" is about a block and a half walk. It is not a resort beach. It is indeed small.
